title: Chapter 1276 - 27: Grand Dao Creation Of Yin And Yang
content:
Chapter 1276 - 27: Grand Dao Creation Of Yin And Yang

Chapter 1276: Chapter 27: Grand Dao Creation of Yin and Yang

Can cultivators... be this powerful?

"If you don’t believe me, my true form is right outside."

Lin Yuan immediately said.

Forcibly entering could lead to the collapse of the test space.

So Lin Yuan still plans to enter through the normal way.

"Wait a moment."

The golden figure steadied themselves.

Although Lin Yuan’s statement was unbelievable, at that moment as Lin Yuan finished speaking,

the forceful intrusion outside quickly calmed down.

This made the golden figure feel that what Lin Yuan said might be true?

The next moment.

The golden figure disappeared from where they stood.

Appearing above the valley outside.

The golden figure looked around, discovering a young man standing quietly there.

The young man’s appearance was identical to Lin Yuan inside the space, but the aura was vastly different.

Utilizing the perceptive power of the test space, the golden figure vaguely sensed the terror of this young man.

As if countless vast worlds were nurtured within him.

"Senior."

Lin Yuan’s true form looked at the golden figure, smiling and greeted.

"You?"

The golden figure took a deep breath.

Upon seeing Lin Yuan’s true form.

He realized that the Lin Yuan outside and Lin Yuan inside the space belonged to the same being, causally connected.

"Do not resist, I will take you in."

Thoughts churned, the golden figure remained silent for a while, then decided to speak.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Boom.

A surge of temporal fluctuation swept through.

Lin Yuan was directly moved into the test space.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit glanced at the true form, transforming into a scorching force and merging within.

"How can he be this strong?"

The golden figure repeatedly observed Lin Yuan.

First of all, Lin Yuan wasn’t a ’demon’, but a normal cultivator.

There is a significant difference between cultivators and ’demons’, akin to clear water and ink.

If a cultivator absorbs Demonic Qi, it’s akin to becoming demonic, like ink dropped into clear water, equally easy to distinguish.

In the eyes of the golden figure, Lin Yuan’s aura was pure, except for being dense almost to the point of being unbelievable, and had no relation to ’demons’.

This is also why the golden figure brought Lin Yuan’s true form into the test space.

After understanding that the tremors in the test space originated from Lin Yuan’s true form.

Bringing Lin Yuan’s true form inside repeatedly confirmed Lin Yuan’s identity as a cultivator.

If he were a demon, a ’demon’ that powerful entering the test space, it wouldn’t be as simple as destroying a test space.

It would also impact the inheritance of the Master of Wushan, and this setup would directly fall through.

"Which Eternal Son are you?"

The golden figure remained silent for a while but couldn’t help asking.

The so-called Eternal Sons are the strongest successors of the Eternal Sect forces, the objects of the Eternal Lord’s focused cultivation.

The strength of an Eternal Son approaches the limit of the Free Three Realms, or some extremely exceptional Eternal Sons have already reached that limit, not weaker than the strong figures within the first two large paintings of this test space.

"Eternal Son?"

"I’m not an Eternal Son."

Lin Yuan looked at the golden figure and spoke.

No need to lie in this regard, Lin Yuan has not currently mastered any Rune Dao inheritance from the Eternal Sect and cannot pose as an Eternal Son.

"Not an Eternal Son."

The golden figure was not surprised.

He only asked casually earlier, and in reality, he didn’t think Lin Yuan was an Eternal Son.

If the Eternal Sect had produced such an exceptional Eternal Son, how could he appear outside this test space?

Various Eternal Lords have set up back-ups to deal with the situation when demonic disasters arrive.

Being the direct lineage of an Eternal Lord as part of the Eternal Sect forces, certainly, there are more complete inheritances to choose from.

Even if it also includes the inheritance of the Master of Wushan, the test space they enter would not be here.

"Senior, I’ll go try again."

Lin Yuan looked at the golden figure and immediately said.

"Go."

The golden figure nodded.

At the same time, a sense of anticipation surged within.

Given the strength Lin Yuan had just showcased, the figures in the first two massive paintings would surely not be able to resist.

As for the third painting? It might not be able to either, but the warrior in the third painting is modeled after the Lord of Heaven Light, and is the most powerful and perfect being among the countless creatures Master of Wu Shan has depicted.

Just uncertain whether he would be stronger or weaker compared to Lin Yuan.

Indeed, the golden figure anticipated the battle between Lin Yuan and the warrior from the third painting to see who was stronger.

Lin Yuan passing the trials was beyond doubt; even if all three warriors from the paintings came forth at once, they wouldn’t be able to stop Lin Yuan.

If even Lin Yuan couldn’t pass the trial, then no cultivator in this realm would be able to.

But not being able to stop does not equate to being weaker than Lin Yuan.

....

A thousand miles away from the central entrance of the realm.

Lin Yuan stepped in once again.

But compared to the first time.

Now, Lin Yuan was no longer in his Taiyang Divine Spirit form.

He was in his true form.

Whoosh.

The first massive painting undulated like flowing water, creating ripples.

The golden armored youth strode out from the scene.

"You again?"

The golden armored youth glanced at Lin Yuan, "I told you, now you are far—"

Before the golden armored youth could finish speaking, his expression slightly changed.

He clearly sensed that the current Lin Yuan was different from before.

"You..."

The golden armored youth’s eyes faintly emitted a golden glow, carefully observing Lin Yuan: "Interesting, I actually sense danger from you?"

The golden armored youth found it hard to believe, being the ultimate life form created by the Master of Wu Shan, he lacked nothing, especially in combat, able to sense even the slightest threat.

"Now I am in my true form."

Lin Yuan said while looking at the golden armored youth: "I will do my best next."

In order to quickly obtain the legacy from the Master of Wu Shan, Lin Yuan had no intention to battle the three warriors in the paintings for three hundred rounds, to understand the essence of their techniques.

These three massive paintings were all created by Master of Wu Shan, obtaining the legacy left by the Master of Wu Shan was far more efficient than comprehending the massive paintings.

"Come."

The golden armored youth showed no sign of underestimating.

In an instant, countless golden runes appeared from all directions, forming an enormous barrier.

Having sensed danger from Lin Yuan, the golden armored youth had no intent to attack proactively, but focused entirely on defense.

His purpose of existence was to prevent any challenger from approaching the central entrance.

Previously attacking Lin Yuan was simply because he didn’t perceive a significant threat from him.

Without any threat, the golden armored youth believed Lin Yuan couldn’t get past him near the entrance, hence he struck, only for fun.

Lin Yuan stood quietly in the void, calmly looking at the golden armored youth treating him as a formidable adversary.

At this moment.

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, fingers forming an invisible grasp, a snow-white light appeared in his palm, expanding swiftly, evolving into a slender sword light.

Lin Yuan’s left hand mirrored the same scene, but the snow-white sword light turned into a pitch-black sword light.

The pitch-black and snow-white sword lights together formed a Yin Yang Taiji Diagram.

Soon the Yin Yang Taiji Diagram transformed into a Yin Yang Taiji Sword.

Chaos Yin Yang Taiji isn’t limited to just the diagram form, it’s capable of evolving into anything within Lin Yuan’s cognition.

However, the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Diagram excels in suppression, which Lin Yuan often uses, and the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Sword excels in attack.

Holding the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Sword, Lin Yuan gently slashed towards the golden armored youth.

Creation Dao sees birth and death.

As if in the primordial chaos when the world first opened, a black and white sword light flashed and vanished.

The countless golden runes gathered with full effort by the golden armored youth were completely severed.

Together with the golden armored youth being sliced into two, his presence dissipating, returning to the painting.

The black and white sword light continued forward.

From the second massive painting, the exceedingly alluring woman stepped out, a sword mark appeared from her forehead downwards, her form shattered, returning to the painting.

The third massive painting.

"Who knows of the great dream, a slumber passes through eternity."

The white-robed man lazily stepped out from the painting, speaking languidly: "You’re the ninth challenger to reach me here..."

Before the white-robed man could finish, he saw an opening sword light slashing towards him.
